newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU economic sentiment rise further in June.
newsitem.headline: EU economic sentiment rise further in June.

text.p: Economic sentiment in the European Union continued to climb in June, with consumers showing the first evidence of renewed confidence since January, the European Commission said on Wednesday.

In a monthly survey of businesses, consumers and industry, the EU executive found that economic conditions improved in virtually all of the bloc's 15 members, with its economic sentiment indicator rising to 101.8 in June from 101.4 in May.
The only countries posting a decline in the index were Germany and Ireland. Both showed a further slide in consumer confidence.
Separately, a survey on manufacturing investment found that spending increased by five percent in volume during 1996 and is expected to grow by three percent this year.
"As economic sentiment is on an improving trend, 1997 investment may become more dynamic than suggested by present investment plans," the survey said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
